frozenQuestion: Are many paper-defined backtracks neutral or improving under global goal distances?
primaryEventUnit: one accepted swap in one logical trace and one goal-direction projection

eventRules.initialTransition: include the transition from the initial state to the first accepted swap
eventRules.distanceOrientation: positive delta is worsening, zero is neutral, negative is improvement
eventRules.schedulerCheckpoints: unchanged scheduler opportunities are counted by run-length weights and are a denominator sensitivity, not duplicated action rows

independentSignFamilies.footrule_transport_global: spearman_footrule (duplicate-aware EMD is the same geometry and is not independent)

primaryEpisodeRule.definition: collapse zero paper-distance deltas, merge consecutive same-sign deltas, and pair each positive worsening run with its immediately following negative recovery run
primaryEpisodeRule.unmatchedTerminalWorsening: retain as an explicit unpaired episode
primaryEpisodeRule.globalAssessment: measure maximum excursion and terminal delta from the state immediately before the paper worsening run over the fixed paper-defined episode boundary

mixedDirectionRule: retain ascending and descending projections as paired sensitivity views; do not pool them as independent observations in primary bootstrap estimates
coverageGapRule: retain all six frozen-C S09 traces in coverage accounting, calculate their observable paper backtracks, and bound global classifications without imputing states
metricDependenceRule: report every frozen S01 variant in the atlas but use only the five named independent sign families for consensus labels and narrative counts
denominatorSensitivities: all scheduler opportunities with unchanged events neutral
primary release traces versus supplemental S06 historical evidence
complete-case estimates and worst-case bounds for the six historical gaps

bootstrap.primaryPopulation: aligned primary release traces with homogeneous native goals
bootstrap.smallStrata: report trace counts and allow degenerate intervals without pretending independent events

representativeSelection.paper_local_only: largest paper-distance worsening among actions with all independent global distances nonworsening
representativeSelection.paper_and_global: largest normalized-Kendall worsening among paper backtracks with any global regression
representativeSelection.global_without_paper: largest normalized-Kendall worsening without a paper backtrack
representativeSelection.tied_local_disagreement: largest paper-versus-adjacent sign divergence in a duplicate-valued trace
representativeSelection.mixed_projection: largest absolute ascending-versus-descending normalized-Kendall delta difference for the same mixed-direction action
representativeSelection.episode: largest paper excursion in each primary episode consensus class

validationGates: raw-normalized sign identity within each metric family
